email.subject: Salt Flat Works: quick fix for mobile visitors
email.body:
Hi Chloe,

I looked at Salt Flat Works Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you customers: it doesn't render properly on phones, and there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors who want to book a brake job or oil change can't just tap to dial you. Most people searching for auto care in Harbor Falls are on their phones, so this probably means missed calls daily.

I also noticed heavy images slowing load time and a footer with outdated info.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's happening and what I'd do?

Alex
Northlight Web
